name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began in the karting circuits of São Paulo, where his natural talent for mechanics quickly became apparent. He transitioned from building and tuning karts for local racers to working as a junior mechanic for a small Formula 3 team. He honed his technical skills and developed a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics. Ricardo gradually climbed the ranks, taking on roles of increasing responsibility. His ability to foster team cohesion, combined with his technical acumen, led to his appointment as Team Principal for United Autosports.

At United Autosports, Ricardo focuses on creating a supportive and collaborative environment. He believes in empowering his team members and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. While he can be hands-on in the garage, he trusts his team's expertise and prefers to focus on long-term strategy and ensuring that the team has the resources it needs to succeed. Ricardo's strength lies in his ability to remain calm under pressure and make crucial decisions in the heat of competition. He is known for his analytical approach and his ability to see the big picture, ensuring that every decision aligns with the team's overall goals.
